title: Terraform observability cell module — canary reconcile, immutability planning, and self-healing hooks
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement a reusable Terraform "cell" module that provisions the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and the log shipping pipeline) for VPC/private deployments with opinionated defaults for safe upgrades, canary rollouts, and self-healing health hooks.

Scope:
- Terraform module that can be instantiated per-VPC or per-cluster (cell) and configurable via inputs for resource sizing, retention, and tiering.
- Manage Prometheus as StatefulSet (or managed Helm release) with scrape config templating, retention, and PVC lifecycle hooks.
- Grafana provisioning for dashboards and API token bootstrap; secure provisioning via KMS-backed secrets.
- OpenTelemetry Collector as Deployment with auto-scaling knobs and a set of transformation pipelines for metrics/traces/logs.
- Log shipping path using Vector/Fluent Bit to S3 and a fallback to centralized log-forwarder; include compression and rotation configs.
- Upgrade strategy: canary deploy config + automated reconcile to detect drift and perform controlled rollbacks.
- Health checks: probe endpoints, integration with console SLO metrics, and automated remediation playbooks (restart pods, scale down/up, alert).
- Inputs/Outputs: clear TF inputs for ingress/egress CIDRs, KMS key ARNs, S3 buckets, and outputs for endpoints, dashboard URLs, and credentials.

Non-goals: Full replacement of the platform orchestration layer; module should integrate with existing orchestration and rollout controllers rather than replace them.
acceptance_criteria: Module can be deployed in a test VPC without manual k8s changes
Canary upgrade flow demonstrates zero data-loss for metrics and logs in 3 test runs
Automated reconcile detects synthetic config drift and triggers the defined remediation hook
Grafana dashboards are bootstrapped and a read-only API token is output to TF state encrypted with KMS
Prometheus PVC migration and retention are preserved across in-place upgrade tests
OTEL Collector pipelines respect configured sampling and forward traces to dev tracing endpoint
tasks: Design TF input schema and examples (minimal, standard, high-throughput)
Implement Prometheus provisioning with optional Helm or native k8s resources
Add Grafana provisioning and dashboard provisioning via Grafana provider
Implement OTEL Collector deployment and default pipelines for metrics/traces/logs
Add Vector/Fluent Bit config templates and S3 sink with rotation/compression
Create canary upgrade harness (k8s job + smoke tests) and reconcile loop scripts
Implement healthcheck probes and remediation hooks (restart, scale, alert)
Write automated tests and upgrade playbook; run in staging and document runbook
Security review: KMS handling, least-privilege IAM roles, and secret rotation guidance
Create examples and docs for private-deployments team and update console to surface endpoints
comments: 2026-02-11 Aisha Patel: Initial design doc posted to Confluence, called out three upgrade patterns (in-place, canary, replace-with-new-cluster) and recommended starting with canary+reconcile as default.

2026-02-18 Luca Martinez: Spike completed for Prometheus Helm vs native StatefulSet trade-offs. Helm gives easier upgrades but harder PVC control; we propose supporting both but exposing PVC control when stateful=true.

2026-02-25 Eng Platform Review: Requested adding explicit KMS-backed secret rotation and ensuring Grafana provisioning does not embed admin credentials in state. Action: use aws_kms_secrets and store tokens in AWS Secrets Manager with rotation policy.
2026-03-02 Infra CI: First pipeline run of module in staging failed due to missing IAM permissions for S3 PutObject; created temporary policy and filed ENG-48354 to tighten roles.
2026-03-05 QA: Canary upgrade run #1: metrics pipeline held but logs lagged ~45s; root cause was vector backpressure config. Patch pending in PR #1429.
2026-03-09 Security: Scoped review done; recommended mandating KMS for dashboard tokens and marking security_review_required. Small IAM role for OTEL collector to only PutTelemetryRecords.
